method: Three repetitions per mode/foreground/revision, before group then after group; 100000 warmup and 2000000 measured calls. Complete marked young-heap growth intervals only; initial/final partial spans omitted. Rounded to 0.1 MiB, rounding bound separately reported.
limitations: Host instrumented observations; not total managed/native allocation rate, object counts, or mobile qualification. Rounded GC durations are not complete pause profiles.
